text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's breaktime at summer camp. I find
Mejiro
McQueen leafing through a
pretty hefty book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you interested too, Trainer?
Care to join
me?
choice_data_list: その本は？
choice_data_list_en: What's that book?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen beckons me over. I sit
down
next to her and take a look at the
book...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's a photo collection which chronicles
the
glorious moments of the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This photo is but one of many. It shows a
plaque
that was earned after an arduous
3,200-meter
journey, a very important
memory to my
grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For every Mejiro, there lies a path
forged by the
greats. Which is why one
day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I, too, want to stand on that peak. I will
achieve
the same dream that was
cherished by the Mejiros
before me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes her time viewing each photo in
the
album. Her eyes give away the
emotions welling
up inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, it's just that this one caught my
eye. It
has a different feeling to the
others.
choice_data_list: どうしたんだ？
どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: What's the matter?
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The photo is a scenic view taken from a
hill.
Observing it, I can almost hear the
whistling
breeze.

Oh my... that's a photo one of our
predecessors
took during their own
summer camp.
choice_data_list: ……とても綺麗な場所だな
……とても綺麗な場所だね
choice_data_list_en: ...It really is a beautiful place.
...It's such a beautiful place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ardan? How long have you been
there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Would you like me to tell you
where this
photo was taken? I will say,
it's a bit of a steep
trek, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan explains the route,
likening the hike
to a challenging
training session.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
According to the instructions Ardan
gave us, first
we enter the dense thicket
on the left and climb
the slope to the
top. All right, let's make haste!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff... Phew... The breeze feels so nice. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with a jovial Mejiro McQueen,
I journey
to the photo's location.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Trainer, I believe we still have some ways to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Is that a hornet?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... The grass is dense, and there are insects aplenty. I suppose this is the great outdoors, though...
choice_data_list: 逃げよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, despite the hurdles,
chooses to
press on. I point out a detour
on the map that
could make it easier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no road out here to follow.
Plus...
choice_data_list: （……これ以上無理はさせたくない）
choice_data_list_en: (...I don't want to push her any harder than this.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scenery we'll find is bound to be the
same as
the photo. As beautiful as it is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Is this the br-bridge?! Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...But we haven't made it there yet.
choice_data_list: ……引き返してもいいんだよ
choice_data_list_en: ...It's okay to turn back, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well, that's because... I've only seen
it in the
photo...
choice_data_list: どうしてそんなに写真の景色を見たいんだ？
どうしてそんなに写真の景色を見たいの？
choice_data_list_en: Why do you want to see the scenery in that photo so badly?
Why do you want to see the scenery in that photo so badly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I haven't experienced it for myself. If I
limit my
dreams to photos and
imagination, I'll never make
them a
reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine, Trainer. As long as your hand
is here
to guide me, I can proceed
forward, past this old
bridge and my
apprehensions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take her hand, we cross the bridge, and
go over
the hills. The two of us press
ahead, never once
looking back...
choice_data_list: ……わかった
choice_data_list_en: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, indeed. But compared to the
photo, this is
much more...
choice_data_list: ここが、写真の場所……！
choice_data_list_en: This is the place from the photo...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I expected it to look like the photo. But
the
reality is far more vibrant. The scent
of the
flowers captures my senses...
choice_data_list: 綺麗だ……
綺麗だね……
choice_data_list_en: It's beautiful...
It's so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...As I thought, you mustn't settle with a
simple
photo or a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If we had cut our journey short, how
would we
have experienced the flowers'
sweet scent, or the
rustling of the
leaves? This beauty would've been
lost
to us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Reality is far more beautiful. More
beautiful than
a photo, my imagination,
or my dreams.
choice_data_list: ……マックイーン？
choice_data_list_en: ...McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze doesn't stop at this scenery. It
extends
beyond, to her road of dreams...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Toward a 3,200-meter journey far more
difficult
than the steep and arduous path
of today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I want to win first place in the spring
Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: （きっと、彼女が見ているのは――）
choice_data_list_en: (Surely, what she's setting her sights on is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For all the people who've supported my

grandmother, my family, and me. The
dream that
they see through us—I want
to make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And just like we experienced today, the

achievement will be far more beautiful in
reality. I
want to see and feel it for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal has not changed from the day
we
met—to win the Tenno Sho, a goal
long sought by
the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, I got a little carried away
there. The
sky feels so close from here.
It's wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Maybe that's why they included this
photo in
the album...
choice_data_list: 先輩たちも同じように夢を語ったのかもな
先輩たちも同じように夢を語ったのかもね
choice_data_list_en: Maybe the seniors talked about their dreams the same way.
Maybe the seniors talked about their dreams the same way too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Maybe that's why they included this
photo in
the album...
choice_data_list: 俺たちも今日の決意を写真に残しておこう
私たちも今日の決意を写真に残しておこう
この景色を目に焼きつけていこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's capture today's resolve in a photo, too.
Let's capture our determination today in a photo too.
Let's burn this view into our memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, we should.
choice_data_list: 俺たちも今日の決意を写真に残しておこう
私たちも今日の決意を写真に残しておこう
この景色を目に焼きつけていこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's capture today's resolve in a photo, too.
Let's capture our determination today in a photo too.
Let's burn this view into our memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This photo will be a reminder of the

determination we felt today. And then,
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, a new runner will travel to this
same
location, and declare their dreams
for the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us remember, how this scenic view
that my
predecessors preserved in a
photo was far more
beautiful in reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That way, the two of us may realize a
dream far
more beautiful than any photo
or any desire
could portray.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I take in the view with Mejiro
McQueen
for a little while longer.
